headline: Post-FY2026 thematic rotation emerging: resources, value and bank-exposed funds entering the top 20 as a South Korean market drop in July dented semiconductor and AI-heavy funds

Resources, value, and bank-oriented funds have started appearing in the top 20 performers. A drop in the South Korean market in July weighed on funds with heavy semiconductor and AI exposure that had topped the FY2026 rankings. She interpreted this as evidence of a thematic rotation reflecting the concentrated and volatile nature of high-growth themes.
